test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A, B and C can complete a work in 10, 15 and 20 days, respectively. They work on alternate days such that 1st day A, 2ⁿd day B and 3rd day C. Again 4th day A, 5th day B and so on. If they work in the same way, in how many days will the work be completed?
solution:
**Given:**

A, B, and C can complete a work in 10, 15, and 20 days, respectively. They work on alternate days such that 1st day A, 2ⁿd day B, and 3rd day C. Again 4th day A, 5th day B, and so on.

**Formula Used:**

Work done by A in 1 day = 1/10

Work done by B in 1 day = 1/15

Work done by C in 1 day = 1/20

Total work done in 3 days = Work done by A + Work done by B + Work done by C

**Calculation:**

LCM of 10, 15 and 20 is 60.

A will work = 60/10 = 6

B will work = 60/15 = 4

C will work = 60/20 = 3

3 days work = 13 unit.

12 days work = 13 × 4 = 52.

13 day work = 52 + 6 = 58.

so 2 unit is left and it will be done by B in 2/4 = 1/ 2 days.

Total work done in 13 + 1/2 = 13(1)/(2)

**∴ The correct answer is 13(1)/(2) days.**
